title: Closeout summary: Sprint 3 - registry inversion and taxonomy cut
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Sprint 3 registry inversion and taxonomy cut is complete. All child tasks are closed with passed verification evidence: bw_work_f8bec47babe97008, bw_work_b7798104fa017b79, bw_work_6d84e592ce2e9e63, bw_work_64cbeba31ce6aeca, and bw_work_bb88a0139ee6fffa. The directive registry is keyed by enforcement gap triggers, taxonomy is collapsed to blocking/required/advisory, dataRequirements have been replaced by typed payload fields, and the old emitted-bundle coherence checker has been retired in favor of focused static registry lint. Line-count evidence against the pre-sprint e09ddf37 baseline: compiler 1369 to 1583, registry 504 to 273, health 382 to 116, snapshot 618 to 622; total 2873 to 2594, net -279 lines.

Close reason: All Sprint 3 children are closed and rollup evidence recorded.
